title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Boise State Broncos and Nebraska Cornhuskers, originally scheduled for Sunday, November 15, 2026 at 1:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Boise State Broncos win, the market will resolve to "Boise State Broncos".
If the Nebraska Cornhuskers win, the market will resolve to "Nebraska Cornhuskers".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Tuesday, November 17, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
